title: allium suaveolens subsp. serotinum
intro: Allium suaveolens subsp. serotinum, commonly known as Serotinum Wild Garlic or Autumn Onion, is a subspecies of wild garlic native to the Iberian Peninsula. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Allium suaveolens subsp. serotinum include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sulfur compounds, which exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic activities.
